trial_court: High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh - CRM-M-20207-2018
case_name: Kajal & Anr vs State Of Punjab And Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: State of Punjab and others (government agency)

facts_of_case: Petitioners Kajal and Arshdeep Singh got married against family wishes, seeking protection from interference in their marital life.

legal_principles.principle: Nobody can be allowed to cause physical harm to the petitioners.
legal_principles.held: However, nobody can be allowed to cause physical harm to the petitioners.

legal_principles.principle: This court will not allow physical harm to the petitioners.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, this petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 - Senior Superintendent of Police, Kapurthala to ensure that no physical harm is caused to the petitioners at the hands of respondents No.4 to 8 or persons claiming through them.

outcome.final_order: Direction to respondent No.2 - Senior Superintendent of Police, Kapurthala to ensure no physical harm is caused to the petitioners.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for protection from family interference
advising on marriage laws and procedures
